headword: {東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}する
reading: とうほんせいそうする
gloss: to rush about; to run around busily

definitions.gloss: to rush about; to run around busily; to be constantly on the go
definitions.explanation: To hurry from place to place in order to accomplish something, especially making efforts to arrange or resolve matters.

examples.japanese: {資金集|しきんあつ}めに{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}する。
{選挙|せんきょ}{運動|うんどう}のために{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}した。
examples.english: I ran around busily for the election campaign.

examples.japanese: {営業|えいぎょう}{部長|ぶちょう}は{新規|しんき}{顧客|こきゃく}を{獲得|かくとく}するために{毎日|まいにち}{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}している。
examples.english: The sales manager is constantly rushing around every day to acquire new clients.

notes:
A four-character idiom ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}): {東|ひがし} (east) + {奔|ほん} (run) + {西|にし} (west) + {走|そう} (run). Literally "running east and dashing west," conveying the image of someone hurrying in all directions. Used in formal and literary contexts to describe someone making great efforts, often with a positive connotation of dedication.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}の{日々|ひび} — days of rushing about
- {資金集|しきんあつ}めに{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}する — rush about raising funds
- {解決|かいけつ}に{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}する — run around trying to resolve something

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {奔走|ほんそう}する — to run about; to make efforts — simpler two-character version, very similar meaning
- {駆|か}け{回|まわ}る — to run around — more colloquial, physical action
- {飛|と}び{回|まわ}る — to fly around — emphasizes rapid movement from place to place
